title: The no-sleep issue is just another confusing part of the Jalen Hurts story

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The no-sleep issue is just another confusing part of the Jalen Hurts story
sources.description: The absence of complete information about the events that led to Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts traveling to London with a blood clot in his leg, playing with a blood clot in his leg, and promptly traveling back to Philadelphia with a blood clot in his leg has resulted in plenty of reports aimed at filling the gaps.
